name: test_fullapi_ui_qml
description: QML-only ui_qml plugin (no C++ backend) that consumes the full_api surface of test_fullapi_cpp directly from QML via the `logos` bridge: logos.callModule for every method type and logos.onModuleEvent / onModuleEventReceived for every typed event, aggregating a single pass/fail token so a headless UI doctest can assert them. bstr is excluded — QML/JS has no native byte literal (the C++-backend variant test_fullapi_ui covers it).
